# Beacon Split

> A desktop workspace for working with several Claude Code sessions at once.
> Each project gets a Claude session, real terminals, a file tree with an
> editor, and git — and its tab says what that project's session is doing, so
> you know which one has stopped and is waiting for an answer without checking
> each in turn.

Free and open source under AGPL-3.0. macOS, on Apple Silicon and Intel, and
Windows 10 and 11 on x64. No account, no telemetry, no server, nothing to buy
later.

## What it is

Beacon Split is a desktop application, not a plugin and not a hosted service.
It runs Claude Code, a shell and git as they are published, rather than
reimplementing any of them. What it adds is the thing a terminal multiplexer
cannot tell you: across every project you have open, which session is working,
which has finished, and which has stopped and is waiting for you.

Sessions live in a background daemon rather than in the window, with their
output buffered, so closing Beacon and reopening it puts you back where you
were instead of starting again.

## Requirements

- macOS, or Windows 10 or 11 on x64. A Linux build is being worked on and has
  never been run, so nothing is claimed about it.
- Claude Code and `git` on the `PATH`. Beacon checks for both the way a session
  finds them — through the login shell, or on Windows the `PATH` itself — and
  says what is missing and how to install it.
- Your own Claude subscription or API key. Beacon never asks for, handles,
  stores or forwards a Claude credential; you sign in yourself and your usage
  is billed to you under your own agreement with Anthropic.

## Installing

Download the `.dmg` for your architecture from the releases page. The build is
not signed with an Apple Developer ID, so macOS refuses it the first time:
after dragging Beacon to Applications, run
`xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Beacon Split.app"` once. Signing
and notarisation need an Apple Developer membership and are on the roadmap.

On Windows, run the `-setup.exe` installer from the same page. It installs for
the current user and needs no administrator. It is not code-signed yet, so
SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC" the first time: choose More info,
then Run anyway.

## Affiliation

Beacon is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or partnered with Anthropic. Claude
and Claude Code are trademarks of Anthropic PBC, used only to say what Beacon
runs.
